title: Tilapia major clinical signs
usage_note: Select and crop individual photographs only after checking their captions. Preserve creator, publisher, source URL and CC BY 4.0 attribution. Do not label a photograph with a diagnosis unless its original caption confirms that diagnosis.

title: Nile tilapia from Lake Sentani showing gross clinical signs of streptococcosis
diagnosis_status: The source associates the image with a confirmed streptococcosis outbreak, but does not link the pictured individual to one bacterial species.
attribution: Adapted by cropping from Anshary H, Kurniawan RA, Sriwulan, Ramli, and Baxa DV (2014), CC BY 4.0.
modification: The lower necropsy panel was removed with the built-in OpenAI image-editing tool; no intentional clinical content was added.
usage_note: Suitable for demonstrating externally visible signs of streptococcosis. Do not label the pictured fish as specifically confirmed S. iniae.

title: Nile tilapia infected with Aeromonas hydrophila
diagnosis_status: The source presents the fish as part of an experimental Aeromonas hydrophila challenge and reports biochemical and species-specific PCR identification of study isolates.
attribution: Shabana SM, Rashed MA, Atia AA, and Abd El-Hady HAM (2025), CC BY 4.0.
modification: Downloaded at the publisher-provided web resolution; no crop or clinical-content modification was made.
usage_note: Suitable for demonstrating external signs associated with A. hydrophila. The image alone must not be treated as confirmation of a user case.

title: Gross Flavobacterium columnare external lesions in Nile tilapia
diagnosis_status: The source presents these as gross external lesions in Nile tilapia experimentally exposed to Flavobacterium columnare. The image alone must not confirm a user case.
attribution: Supplemental Figure 1 from Fajei E, Cai WC, Whyte SK, Despres B, Dixon B, Carpio Y, Estrada M, and Fast MD (2024), CC BY-NC 4.0.
modification: Exported from Supplemental Figure 1 as a combined two-panel JPEG; surrounding slide whitespace and caption were omitted, while the panel labels, arrows and clinical content were preserved.
usage_note: Suitable for non-commercial demonstration of externally visible signs following F. columnare exposure. Do not treat the image alone as diagnostic confirmation.
